title: Policy semantics: the engine, an independent reference model and the replay verifier agree
note: Section 6.2 (D-2026-172). The engine half is killed by the comparison with a reference written from the stated semantics (Cedar-shaped: permit and forbid sets, forbid overrides, default deny), the second-reader half by the replay comparison and the forged-verdict cases. tests/test_policy_semantics.py holds each. The reference is test-only; nothing at runtime calls it.

mutations.name: PS1_the_first_match_decides
mutations.replace:
if denies and matched[0].effect is Effect.DENY:
            r = denies[0]
mutations.rationale: 6.2: an ALLOW listed before a DENY overrides it -- first-match, not deny-overrides

mutations.name: PS2_the_last_deny_decides
mutations.rationale: 6.2: the determining forbid is not the first in document order

mutations.name: PS3_obligations_of_the_deciding_allow_only
mutations.find: attached = sorted({o for a in allows for o in a.obligations})
mutations.rationale: 6.2: a broad grant listed first drops a narrower grant's obligations

mutations.name: PS4_a_wildcard_request_matches_everything
mutations.find: return ANY in allowed or value in allowed
mutations.replace: return ANY in allowed or value in allowed or value == ANY
mutations.rationale: 6.2: a request that names '*' is granted what no rule spelled out

mutations.name: PS5_a_rule_ignores_the_resource
mutations.rationale: 6.2: a rule scoped to one resource holds of every resource

mutations.name: PS6_the_second_reader_trusts_the_verdict
mutations.find:
if got != want:
            _note(out, ev, f"a decision the rules of {pid!r} do not give: "
mutations.replace:
if False:
            _note(out, ev, f"a decision the rules of {pid!r} do not give: "
mutations.rationale: 6.2: a verdict the rules do not give passes the independent reader

mutations.name: PS7_the_second_reader_forgets_the_wildcard
mutations.find: return all("*" in (r.get(f) or ()) or req.get(k) in (r.get(f) or ())
mutations.rationale: 6.2: honest decisions under '*' rules are reported as forgeries

mutations.name: PS8_the_second_reader_lets_the_first_match_decide
mutations.find: deny = next((r for r in held if r.get("effect") == "DENY"), None)
mutations.replace: deny = next((r for r in held[:1] if r.get("effect") == "DENY"), None)
mutations.rationale: 6.2: the restatement is first-match, the engine deny-overrides

mutations.name: PS9_the_second_reader_names_the_last_deny
mutations.find: deny = next((r for r in held if r.get("effect") == "DENY"), None)
mutations.replace: deny = next((r for r in reversed(held) if r.get("effect") == "DENY"), None)
mutations.rationale: 6.2: the restated determining forbid is the last, not the first

mutations.name: PS10_the_second_reader_takes_one_allow_s_obligations
mutations.find: sorted({o for r in allow for o in r.get("obligations") or ()}))
mutations.rationale: 6.2: the restated obligations are the deciding rule's alone

mutations.name: PS11_the_second_reader_ignores_the_resource
mutations.rationale: 6.2: the restatement drops a field the engine conjoins

mutations.name: PS12_the_second_reader_judges_under_the_first_version
mutations.rationale: 6.2: a decision is restated under superseded rules
